verdict.rationale: Jan ships a local OpenAI-compatible REST API at localhost:1337. The documented endpoints are GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (streaming, tool calling) and an Anthropic-compatible POST /v1/messages, so chat inference is scriptable. The UI's other features have no documented API equivalent: Hub model download and import, assistants and project assignment, MCP setup and tool approval, and settings. Parity is therefore far from complete. Missing for 10: API endpoints for model download/import/management, assistant and project CRUD, MCP/tool configuration, thread and settings management, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and any stated UI–API parity commitment.
